description: This pie chart illustrates the "Distribution of data source in the combined training set," displaying a total of thirteen distinct categories. The chart does not utilize a separate legend or place percentage labels inside the slices; instead, each category is identified by a text label and an exact percentage positioned outside the pie, connected to its corresponding slice by a thin grey line. Proceeding clockwise from the top right, the slices include NQ in blue (31.3%), a very thin dark grey sliver for SCIFACT (0.1%), ENTFA in yellow (1.8%), FACTCC in green (2.6%), ANLI in orange (4.6%), FEVER in teal (16.1%), a tiny light blue sliver for MULTIFC (0.5%), MULTINLI in light red (11.3%), a small yellow sliver for PUBHEALTH (0.5%), SCITAIL in light green (1.2%), SNLI in light orange (15.4%), VITAMINC in cyan (13.0%), and XSUMHUL in pale purple (1.6%). The segments are not arranged in any apparent order of size, such as ascending or descending, and none of the slices are visually emphasized through exploding, offsetting, or bolding.
